required_artifacts: A running QEMU process configured with the specified image and snapshot mode
A VNC server listening on port 5901 for display :1
An nginx service listening on port 80 providing web access
Evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Evidence that QEMU accepts programmatic keyboard input beyond VNC-only interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU must use snapshot mode so the base image remains immutable
VNC must be reachable on :1 / port 5901
nginx must be configured and listening on port 80
The VM must remain running in the background after setup
Keyboard input must be injectable programmatically for automated testing

Treating environment prerequisites as task completion

Launch QEMU with the required flags and capture the exact command/receipt
Verify the QEMU process remains running in the background
Verify VNC is listening on port 5901 and nginx on port 80
Use a programmatic input mechanism to send keystrokes to the VM and capture evidence
Confirm the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop via VNC or other measurable evidence
Only finalize when all required behaviors are supported by receipt-backed evidence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed QEMU launch command showing snapshot mode and /app/isos/win311.img
